The rarest and most dangerous Rift Echo — the death-imprint of a powerful warrior who died in direct contact with a major Rift surge. Death knights retain full combat prowess and tactical intelligence from their living selves, making them far more dangerous than fragmentary Echoes. They command lesser Echoes as instinctively as they once commanded soldiers.
## Traits
**Magic Resistance.** Advantage on saves against spells.
**Marshal Rift-touched.** Unless the rift death knight is incapacitated, it and Rift-touched creatures of its choice within 60 feet have advantage on saves against effects that turn Rift-touched.
**Spellcasting.** 19th-level paladin (CHA, DC 18, +10). Wide spell selection.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Three longsword attacks.
**Longsword.** +11 to hit, 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing + 18 (4d8) necrotic.
**Hellfire Orb.** The rift death knight hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes at a point it can see within 120 feet. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere must make a DC 18 DEX save, taking 35 (10d6) fire + 35 (10d6) necrotic on failure, or half on success. Recharges 6.
